description: Spectrum analyser, four channels, plotted on one display

params.text: Averages frames to steady the plot, at the cost of lag
The FFT size, traded against CPU
The window function applied before the FFT

notes: click and hold the display to freeze it and read each channel's level at the frequency under the pointer
menu: Frequency plot — plots the frequency axis Logarithmic or Linear
Amplitude plot — sets the vertical scale: Decibels to -60dB, Decibels To -120dB, or Linear percentage, where 100% is 0dB
